controls.label: Connect Pi
controls.action: Connect to the saved Raspberry Pi robotics API without enabling teleop or moving hardware.

controls.label: Open Cameras
controls.action: Open the unified left wrist, right wrist, and ZED POV camera window.

controls.label: Training data
controls.action: Open robot datasets and synchronized episode artifacts.

controls.label: Robot files
controls.action: Open the robotics-specific project file explorer.

controls.label: MuJoCo
controls.action: Open the simulation view. This does not move physical hardware.

controls.label: Preflight
controls.action: Run reset, calibration, limits, connection, and guarded-home checks before a physical run.

controls.label: Home robot
controls.action: Stop motion producers and slowly move both arms to the feedback-checked arms-down home pose after confirmation.

controls.label: Recover home
controls.action: Clear a latched software stop only through the guarded recovery and home sequence after confirmation.

controls.label: KILL / DISABLE NOW
controls.action: Immediately stop teleop, emotes, playback, and motion producers and disable the robot. This is the only immediate physical assistant action.

controls.label: Hey AI
controls.action: Start the shared voice assistant. Robotics reasoning uses the AI prompt model and prefers the selected connected subscription.

controls.label: Voice settings
controls.action: Open voice model, realtime voice, volume, wake name, and context-sharing settings.

controls.label: Render Agent
controls.action: Open actionable robotics chat with the active project and indexed Robotics Home controls in context.
